Incredible experience!
Sep 2026 • Couples
My partner and I had a wonderful dinner at The Palm while visiting Ho Chi Minh City. The food was excellent, the atmosphere was beautiful, and what really made the evening stand out was the service.

Our server, Nghi Dinh, was incredibly kind, polite, and attentive. She took the time to explain our dishes as they arrived and also shared some wonderful insight into Ho Chi Minh City and Vietnam with us. As visitors, we really appreciated that personal touch—it made the evening feel especially welcoming and memorable.

We both started with the Tuna Ceviche. I also had the bone marrow and squid ink tagliatelle with lobster, while my partner had the Baked Salmon. We finished with the Chocolate Fondant. Everything was beautifully presented and delicious, and the meal felt thoughtful from beginning to end.

A fantastic dining experience and one of the highlights of our time in Ho Chi Minh City. A special thank you to Nghi for taking such great care of us and making our evening feel so special. We would absolutely recommend The Palm and would happily return.

The Palm was DELICIOUS
Sep 2026 • Couples
We had such a wonderful experience at The Palm in Ho Chi Minh City. The food was exquisite, the wine was delicious, and the whole evening was made even better by the incredible service.

Our server, Nghi Dinh, was absolutely lovely. She was so warm, attentive, and genuinely thoughtful throughout the entire meal. You could really feel how much she and the team cared about making sure their guests had a great experience. It wasn’t just good service, there was a real sense of care and dedication that made us feel very welcomed.

As a New Yorker who loves dining out and has had the opportunity to eat at restaurants all over the world, I really appreciate when a restaurant gets both the food and the hospitality right. The Palm definitely did.

We left feeling very happy with the experience and would absolutely recommend The Palm to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City. And if you go, hopefully you’ll be lucky enough to have Nghi taking care of you!

Outstanding Beef Wellington & Perfectly Cooked Salmon
Jul 2026 • Couples
We had a wonderful dinner at The Palm Restaurant & Bar and were impressed from start to finish.

I ordered the Beef Wellington, and it was exceptional. The beef was cooked perfectly medium-rare, incredibly tender and full of flavour. The pastry was crisp and buttery, while the mushroom duxelles added a rich, earthy depth without overpowering the beef. Served with creamy mashed potato, grilled asparagus and a delicious red wine jus, it was one of the best Beef Wellingtons I've had.

My wife chose the baked salmon, which was equally outstanding. The salmon had beautifully crisp skin while remaining moist and flaky inside. It was accompanied by a Mediterranean-style olive and tomato relish with a silky pumpkin purée, creating a combination of flavours that was both fresh and beautifully balanced.

Both dishes were presented with great attention to detail and were clearly prepared using high-quality ingredients. The service was warm (Bao Le) professional and attentive throughout the evening, and the atmosphere made for a relaxed and enjoyable dining experience.

The Palm Restaurant & Bar is a real gem in Ho Chi Minh City. We'll definitely be returning and wouldn't hesitate to recommend it to anyone looking for an excellent meal.
